thread:
sara: Hey all — finalizing PRD launch criteria for Private + Dedicated keystore handling. Need alignment on retention windows and acceptance criteria before Monday.

kyle: quick q — are we requiring HSM for customer-managed keys or is KMS with envelope ok for initial launch?

priya: Security preference is HSM for keys that encrypt customer LLM data at rest, but we can allow cloud KMS with attested keys for early customers. must document risk and fallback.

anita: Legal: SOC2 evidence will need key rotation logs + access logs for 12 months. Can we export signed log bundles? :thinking_face:

josh: We can add an export endpoint that generates gzipped signed bundles. Need to confirm retention and PII redaction rules.

elena: devex note — include CLI snippet for generating the export `redwoodctl export-keystore-logs --since=30d --format=zip`

priya: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- KMS/HSM selection documented per customer tier
- Rotation events logged and available via export
- Audit bundle contains: rotation, access, admin ops, with tamper-evidence
- Retention policy settable per org (default 12m)
- Private/on-prem: offline export path documented

kyle: Edge case: customer air-gapped on-prem can't call cloud KMS. We need a local HSM workflow and manual evidence generation. Added to PRD.

sara: Good — add a canary launch path: 5 customers on Dedicated with KMS only, 2 on HSM. Monitor audit export turnaround and support load.

anita: Also add required SOC2 evidence checklist: timestamps synchronized (NTP), signed logs, key custody attestations.

priya: Risk: key compromise scenario — acceptance should include documented revocation and key-rewrap procedure and customer notification SLA.

josh: Implementation note: we'll store rotation metadata in secure ledger `keystore.audit_v1` (internal) and create a signed manifest for each export.

elena: UX ask — surface export status in Console and send email/webhook when bundle ready.

sara: Action items:
- @kyle to draft HSM onboarding steps (due Wed)
- @josh to prototype export endpoint + sample bundle (due Thu)
- @priya + @anita to finalize acceptance checklist for SOC2 review (due Fri)
- @elena to wire Console status + webhook (TBD)

kyle: ack, will start a short RFC and ping here when ready :thumbsup: 

infra-bot: deploy:keystore-audit-service succeeded for branch `keystore-export-proto` — build 202

sara: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or drop notes here. We'll aim to lock PRD Friday EOD.
